Tournament progress now uses ten explicit save slots. Choose Save tournament from Pause, an introduction or a result card; every slot shows the player and timestamp. Occupied slots require confirmation. Load tournament restores the chosen frame, including a shot in flight, and pauses live play until Resume play.

Automatic progress saving and the old Resume Last Saved Match flow have been removed. Existing legacy save files are left untouched but are not loaded. Preferences and the Top Ten remain separate local records. The three retry diamonds still buy rematches; their wording now distinguishes retries from saved games.

Fixed Pause navigation so Resume play remains available after Save/Load, Journey or Help. Added separate victory and defeat expression artwork for all 48 rivals, with 96 individual on-screen result lines. Optional result-voice filenames and exact lines are included in the audio documentation; recorded rival voices are not bundled.

Linux x86-64 only, offline. Source and original artwork: Apache-2.0; bundled music and fonts retain the terms in NOTICE.
